verses.1: After these things the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision: "Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield and your exceedingly great reward."
verses.2: But Abram said, "Lord GOD, what will you give me? I remain childless, and the heir of my household is Eliezer of Damascus."
verses.3: Abram also said, "You have given me no offspring, and a member of my household will be my heir."
verses.4: Then the word of the LORD came to him: "This man will not be your heir; your very own son will be your heir."
verses.5: He brought him outside and said, "Look up at the heavens and count the stars, if you are able to count them." Then he said to him, "So shall your offspring be."
verses.6: Abram believed the LORD, and He counted it to him as righteousness.
verses.7: Then he said to him, "I am the LORD who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to possess."
verses.8: But Abram said, "Lord GOD, how can I know that I will possess it?"
verses.9: The LORD said to him, "Bring me a three-year-old heifer, a three-year-old female goat, a three-year-old ram, a turtledove, and a young pigeon."
verses.10: Abram brought all these animals, cut them in half, and laid each half opposite the other. But he did not cut the birds in half.
verses.11: When birds of prey came down on the carcasses, Abram drove them away.
verses.12: As the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram, and behold, a great and dreadful darkness fell upon him.
verses.13: Then the LORD said to Abram, "Know for certain that your offspring will be strangers in a land that is not their own, and they will be enslaved and oppressed there for four hundred years.
verses.14: But I will judge the nation they serve, and afterward they will come out with great possessions.
verses.15: As for you, you will go to your fathers in peace and be buried at a good old age.
verses.16: In the fourth generation your descend1ants will return here, for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet complete."
verses.17: When the sun had gone down and darkness had fallen, a smoking fire pot and a flaming torch passed between the pieces.
verses.18: On that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, "To your offspring I give this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates —
verses.19: the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,
verses.20: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,
verses.21: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites."

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
